title: Sliding Puzzle: Crafting Playable Demos with 3D Slicing and Touch Feedback
subtitle: A minimal playable prototype of the classic 15-puzzle: scramble → slide → solve validation. We leverage 3D perspective and dynamic lighting to turn flat tiles into tangible objects, while subtle animations like sliding, bouncing, and highlighting clarify moveability and significantly enhance tactile feedback without heavy performance costs.

breakdown.title: Core Elements of the Minimal Playable Demo
bullets: Slice a single image into a grid and reserve an empty space
Interactive movement: only allow tiles adjacent to the empty space to slide
Validate the solved state and trigger a win settlement

breakdown.title: Why 3D and Animations Add Value
bullets: Perspective and lighting make tiles feel like physical 3D objects
Sliding, bouncing, and highlighting animations clearly communicate moveability rules
Lightweight animations significantly boost tactile feedback and engagement
